Tsk… this is uncomfortable.
啧……真不得劲。
dataList.place:
Wuthering Heights Front Gate
呼啸山庄 大门

dataList.content:
Oi, is it normal for these clothes to squeeze harder with every step I take?
我每走一步，衣服就会勒我一下。

That is what it means to maintain an air of dignity~ Once you get used to that feeling, you'll feel like you're missing something whenever you're dressed casually!
所谓的气度本来就是这样的~在你习惯以后，反而会在穿其他衣服的时候感到空虚呢。

So this must be the front… gate to your former place of abode, Heathcliff.
希斯克利夫……这就是你之前生活过的地方的大门……吗。

The massive gate alone feels downright intimidating.
这是一扇让人感到压迫感的……巨大门扉。

<That's one big front door.>
<光是大门的大小就很吓人。>

It is known that, in certain regions of the City, the size of the front gate is an indicator of one's social standing. The magnitude of this front gate indicates that... the owner of this home is very affluent.
有些地方以大门的大小展示身份地位。以这种程度的大小来看……其为相当富裕的豪门。

Heathcliff, you picked on Hong Lu for being a rich kid when you were raised at some huge mansion yourself?
明明曾在这种地方生活……你却因为鸿璐先生是有钱人而固执地对他展现恶意呢，希斯克利夫？

Heh heh, I don't mind it at all~
呼呼，我并不介意呢~

... I'm feeling a bit betrayed, actually.
……我突然觉得被背叛了。

Sir Heathcliff, thou appeareth quite different today...
希斯克利夫先生……唯有今日，汝看起来尤为陌生……

... Keep your stupid comments to yourselves.
……别废话了。

Some were teasing him, and some were genuinely surprised, but... it didn't matter to Heathcliff. Every word he spat out was dripping with venomous spite.
有几个人是在开玩笑，有几个则是真心对他的出身感到惊讶，而希斯克利夫只是露出愤怒的眼神低吼着。

I wasn't even remotely close to being rich.
有钱的可不是我。

I was never once 'rich' in this manor. I wasn't even allowed to be content. Not even for a moment.
在这座宅邸中，哪怕只有一刻……我都不曾富裕过。

And this manor. This manor never accepted me, not even for a—
这座宅邸也是，连一刻也没有接受……

W-what the hell...
什、什么呀，这是……

A lightning strike. It seems to have struck an area near the forest.
落雷。推测落点为后方的森林附近。

<That was so loud...>
<真是响亮的声音……>

It's okay. I-I heard that it's extremely rare for lightning to actually hit people.
没事的。听、听说人被闪电击中的几率非常渺茫……

... A momentary musing reveals that a strike of levin brings about a sensation that is not unlike the joy of fireworks.
若仔细思考……就会发现闪电与烟花有诸多相似之处。

It fills the dark and cold void of the night sky with its incandescent brilliance, even for a brief moment, before fading away into oblivion.
它们都会以瞬间的闪光填满空荡的夜空，随后消失。

… Right. And in exchange, it loses everything it has, burning and leaving nothing but ash behind.
……取而代之的是，它会将自己拥有的一切全然释放，而后又将一切燃烧殆尽。

What joy is there to be found?
这可不是玩闹。

I could hear some forest critters fleeing, spooked by the thunderstrike.
不知是否是刚才落雷的影响，林中传来了动物们受惊而逃的声音。

Ooh! Behold, a tiny squirrel over yonder!
噢！快看那里！有只小松鼠！

Woah… such nature so close to home? I didn't know you used to live at such an eco-friendly place. I suppose I wouldn't have to go through the trouble of building a private zoo if I lived at a place like this!
哇，你家附近就是森林……原来你住在这么亲近自然的地方啊。看来没必要单独建设动物园呢！

To have a garden or a forest so near their home… Even if we were to ignore everything else, that alone indicates that its owner is someone of unimaginable affluence.
在都市拥有庭院或森林都无疑表明其主人是位大富豪。

Hmm~ Right! I remember that Sinclair's home was in the middle of a forest, too.
嗯~也是，辛克莱的家也是这样。

Squirrels, sure. There were other animals roaming about, too.
那里有松鼠，也经常能看到一些动物。

Sometimes, when I was so miserable that I could hardly bear to even be in that manor... I’d go to the forest and not return for a long, long time.
我有时心情烦躁得难以抑制时就会一直呆在森林里。

Ooh, then this tiny forest friend, little Sir Squirrel, must have been quite the jolly companion for thee!
噢噢……每当那个时候，松鼠便会成为汝为数不多的友人……！

LITTLE SIR SQUIRRELLLLLL!!!!!!!!!!!
小松鼠！！！！！！！！！！！！

The little squirrel that may once have been Heathcliff’s tiny forest friend…
曾经可能是希斯克利夫朋友的小松鼠，

… was immediately scorched down to a pile of ash the moment it crossed over into the manor’s front gate.
在越过大门的瞬间，就立刻被闪电劈成了焦炭。

That was… a weird lightning strike. Did it just curve midair?
闪电通常……会以那种形式劈下来吗？还会弯曲……

The chance of such an occurrence is extraordinarily low.
一般情况下，这种事情发生的概率极低。

Um… it might just be that I’m overreacting, but it looked as though that lightning was curving itself to strike exactly where that squirrel was standing.
呃……虽然可能是我反应过度了，但怎么看都是闪电精确地向那只松鼠劈去……

Woah… Heathcliff, I had no idea you grew up at such a dangerous place. I’m impressed you even survived…
你在这种危险的地方活下来了呢，希斯克利夫先生……

… No. Blimey… I’ve not seen anything like it.
……不，啧……我也是第一次……看到这种落雷。

<Right, Heathcliff. Ready to knock on the front gate?>
<来，希斯克利夫。准备好敲门了吗？>

The front gate…
大门……

He stared blankly at the front gate of the manor.
希斯克利夫茫然地望向宅邸的大门。

I've... not knocked on this gate in good many years.
敲门……真是久违了。

I once had to wait out here for hours because they all refused to let me in. Everyone... except Catherine. She snuck out of the manor to open it for me.
有一次……因为没有任何人帮我开门，所以凯瑟琳偷偷从宅邸溜出来帮我开了门。

Walking through the heavy rain.
冒着雨。

Well, then... I’m sure it won’t be different this time.
那现在也是一样。

So if I knock... Catherine will come out to let me in?
你是说如果我敲了这扇门……凯瑟琳就会出现？

Heathcliff takes a deep breath before knocking on the front door.
深呼吸过后，希斯克利夫敲响了大门。

Huh, nothing. That’s not what I meant when I said it won't be different this time…
我没想过会是这种情况……

Oh, we can try climbing over the fence. I think we can clear that height as long as we’re okay with breaking our ankles…
……啊，要不我们翻墙进去？看高度，只要我们做好扭伤脚踝的心理准备……

No.
不。

Heathcliff was a whole bundle of anxiety before he knocked on the front gate, but…
虽然希斯克利夫直到敲门前还都神色慌张……

… perhaps this perceived slight reverted Heathcliff into his usual, angry self.
但他似乎认为自己已经被无视，于是变得和平日一样的充满愤怒。

I was invited to this manor! This invitation would be meaningless if I were to leap over the fence.
我是被这座宅邸邀请的。翻墙进去的话，一切都会变得毫无意义。

CATHERINE! I’M BACK!
凯瑟琳！我回来了！

They’ve ignored you once. Continuing to shout won’t—
被无视过一次后，任你再怎么大喊大叫也……

CATHERINE!
凯瑟琳！

Despite his efforts, not even a soul stirred beyond the front gate. None of us really believed that anyone would come out to greet him.
没什么罪人认为只要希斯克利夫向空空如也的大门喊话就能将它打开。当然我也一样。

But…
但是……

CATH—
凯瑟……

The front gate began to creak open as though someone was answering his pleas.
就像真的回应了他的呼喊一样，大门应声而开。

… The makeover was worth it, hmm?
……看来打扮还是很值得的，不是吗？
